title: aglaomorpha mollis
intro: Aglaomorpha mollis, commonly known as the Soft Shield Fern, is a species of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. The Soft Shield Fern has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. It is believed to have therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving pain and discomfort, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the Soft Shield Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
